a: DHCP assigns IP configuration to hosts automatically.
ARP maps IP addresses to MAC addresses on a LAN.
ICMP carries diagnostics like ping echo requests.
MTU is the maximum packet size for a network link.
TCP congestion control adapts send rate to network conditions.
Recursive resolvers fetch answers on behalf of clients.
Anycast routes to the nearest of many locations sharing an IP.
BGP exchanges routing information between autonomous systems.
TLS handshake negotiates keys and authenticates the server.
HTTP/3 runs over QUIC for improved multiplexed transport.
